light.line: Marshfield High School's Marine Corps JROTC program is back after a four-year effort to bring it home. Persistence pays, one push-up at a time.
A group of volunteers took it upon themselves to spend a Saturday in September restoring the Colonel Miles Vernon Cemetery. Neighbors with rakes make the best heroes.
At Camdenton, the same families keep returning to play football on the same field, with fathers and sons both wearing the jersey. Hand-me-down pride never goes out of style.
